name: Microed Sports Manager
author: Microed Sistemas

sections.description:
Microed Sports Manager is a complete, lightweight solution to manage sports competitions directly inside WordPress. No external services, no page builders and no monthly fees — create your teams, championships and cups, register scores and attendance, and publish the results on your site in minutes.

Create and manage your competitions

  • Teams and athletes — register name, age, number and position for every athlete.
  • Championships — round-robin / points-based leagues with automatic standings.
  • Cups — knockout, groups and multi-phase formats.
  • Venues — locations for your games.
  • Games — score, WO (walkover), date/time, venue and attendance (paid/total).
  • Calendar and champions history — keep track of every edition and every champion.
  • Top scorers — goals/points ranking by athlete on the public results page.

Match reports, lineups and export come with the Pro add-on

Match reports with referees, lineups with goals/points, athlete events, tournament regulations, live match stopwatch and export (CSV, print and HTML) are part of the Sports Manager Pro add-on — a separate premium plugin that builds on this free base.

Publish results on your site

The public results page shows standings, fixtures, charts and top scorers with friendly URLs and a clean, configurable layout:

  • Friendly URLs (slug) for every championship and cup.
  • Configurable colors and fonts to match your theme.
  • Configurable per-game attendance (paid/total).
  • Search and pagination for competitions.
  • Shortcode [sports_manager_results] for total layout control — or use the “Leagues” and “Cups” pages created automatically on activation.

Where is your data stored?

Your data lives in your own WordPress database, in tables with the sm_ prefix (for example wp_sm_teams). There is no cloud, no third-party service and no lock-in: uninstalling the plugin removes the data if you want.

Localization

The plugin is fully internationalized and translation-ready. Translations are managed through translate.wordpress.org and distributed automatically by the standard WordPress translation update system.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sports-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the new “Sports Manager” menu to start creating teams, championships and cups.
  4. To show public results, create a page with the shortcode [sports_manager_results] (or use the auto-created “Leagues” and “Cups” pages).
sections.faq:
How do I create a championship?

Go to Sports Manager → Leagues and click “New championship (round robin)”.

How do I show the results to visitors?

Create a page with the [sports_manager_results] shortcode, or use the “Leagues” and “Cups” pages created automatically on activation.

Where are the data stored?

In the same WordPress database, using tables with the sm_ prefix (for example wp_sm_teams).

Can I get match reports, lineups and export?

Yes — those features are part of the Sports Manager Pro add-on: match reports with referees, lineups with goals/points, athlete events, tournament regulations, live match stopwatch and export (CSV, print and HTML). The free plugin focuses on standings, fixtures, results, attendance and top scorers.
